Question: You have already given your answer to my question in fatwa number 1871, regarding the sucking of genitals. but my husband refuses to believe this, & i'm forced into this act. He insists it's not written anywhere in Sahih Bukhari or Muslim, and is probably a zaeef hadith. Can you please give me the exact hadith with the number so that i can show it to him? thank you. Answer ID: 5032 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1056/891=B/1429) This is proved neither from a sahih hadith nor from a za?eef hadith. It is animalistic and shamelessness. Hazrat Aaishah says that neither she nor he (the Prophet) had seen the private parts of each other.
